<div class="wp-block-group has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">

<p class="has-small-font-size has-contrast-2-color has-text-color wp-block-paragraph">by</p>

<div class="entry-content alignfull wp-block-post-content has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained">
<h5 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>GR&#8217;s Einstein Field Equations, QM&#8217;s Canonical Commutation Relation, and the Second Law of Thermodynamics Unified as Three Instances of One Theorem of dx₄/dt = ic</strong>: <strong>The Unification of Classical Statistical Mechanics, Quantum Mechanics, and Gravity as Lorentzian and Euclidean Signature-Readings of Iterated McGucken Sphere Propagation, and dx₄/dt = ic as the Source of Holography and AdS/CFT</strong></h5>



<div data-wp-interactive="core/file" class="wp-block-file"><object data-wp-bind--hidden="!state.hasPdfPreview" hidden class="wp-block-file__embed" data="https://elliotmcguckenphysics.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/1_gr_einstein_field_equations_qm_canonical_commutation_relation_and_second_law_of_thermodynamics_unified_as_three_instances_of_dx4dt_eq_ic.pdf" type="application/pdf" style="width:100%;height:600px" aria-label="Embed of 1_GR_Einstein_Field_Equations_QM_Canonical_Commutation_Relation_and_Second_Law_of_Thermodynamics_Unified_as_Three_Instances_of_dx4dt_eq_ic."></object><a id="wp-block-file--media-75bcaa56-e17b-4584-9d69-cc7e8434e748" href="https://elliotmcguckenphysics.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/1_gr_einstein_field_equations_qm_canonical_commutation_relation_and_second_law_of_thermodynamics_unified_as_three_instances_of_dx4dt_eq_ic.pdf">1_GR_Einstein_Field_Equations_QM_Canonical_Commutation_Relation_and_Second_Law_of_Thermodynamics_Unified_as_Three_Instances_of_dx4dt_eq_ic</a><a href="https://elliotmcguckenphysics.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/1_gr_einstein_field_equations_qm_canonical_commutation_relation_and_second_law_of_thermodynamics_unified_as_three_instances_of_dx4dt_eq_ic.pdf" class="wp-block-file__button wp-element-button" download aria-describedby="wp-block-file--media-75bcaa56-e17b-4584-9d69-cc7e8434e748">Download</a></div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Dr. Elliot McGucken</strong><br><em>Light Time Dimension Theory</em><br><em>elliotmcguckenphysics.com · <a href="mailto:drelliot@gmail.com">drelliot@gmail.com</a></em><br><em>May 2026</em></p>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>&#8220;More intellectual curiosity, versatility and yen for physics than Elliot McGucken&#8217;s I have never seen in any senior or graduate student. Originality, powerful motivation, and a can-do spirit make me think that McGucken is a top bet.&#8221;</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>— John Archibald Wheeler, Joseph Henry Professor of Physics, Princeton University</em></p>
</blockquote>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>&#8220;Henceforth space by itself, and time by itself, are doomed to fade away into mere shadows, and only a kind of union of the two will preserve an independent reality.&#8221;</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>— Hermann Minkowski, address to the 80th Assembly of German Natural Scientists and Physicians, Cologne, September 21, 1908.</em></p>
</blockquote>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Abstract</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Einstein field equations <em>G_μν + Λg_μν = (8πG/c⁴) T_μν</em> in GR, the canonical commutation relation <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em> in QM, and the Second Law of Thermodynamics <em>dS/dt = (3/2) k_B/t &gt; 0</em> (massive particles) and <em>dS/dt = 2k_B/t &gt; 0</em> (photons on the McGucken Sphere) are unified as three derived instances of one theorem of the McGucken Principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> which states that the fourth dimension is expanding in a spherically-symmetric manner at the velocity of light. Each of three instances from GR, QM, and Thermodynamics admit two path-independent derivations starting from <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> — an algebraic-symmetry route (McGucken Channel A, Lorentzian signature) and a geometric-propagation route (McGucken Channel B, Euclidean signature via the <em>McGucken-Wick rotation τ = x₄/c</em>) — that converge on the same physical equation through structurally disjoint intermediate machinery. <em>The McGucken-Wick rotation is distinguished here from Wick&#8217;s 1954 formal analytic continuation device: in the present framework τ = x₄/c is not a calculational manoeuvre but a coordinate identification on the real four-manifold whose fourth axis is physically expanding at velocity c via dx₄/dt = ic, which forces the Wick rotation.</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Previous papers in the McGucken corpus have derived gravity, quantum mechanics, and thermodynamics as chains of theorems descending from <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> [W, F, MQF, MGT, GRQM]; the present paper offers further proof that <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is a foundational aspect of physical reality underlying all empirically observed physics. This paper demonstrates yet more remarkable aspects of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>: <em><strong>First</strong></em>, the structural agreement of quantum mechanics and classical statistical mechanics observed for 75 years — the Feynman-Kac correspondence, Nelson stochastic mechanics, Osterwalder-Schrader reflection positivity, Parisi-Wu stochastic quantization, the entire constructive Euclidean field theory programme — is forced: QM and classical statistical mechanics are signature-readings of one geometric process <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> (iterated McGucken Sphere expansion on the McGucken manifold), and the agreement could not have been otherwise. <em><strong>Second</strong></em>, the structural agreement of Hilbert and Jacobson on the Einstein field equations observed for 30 years is forced by the same mechanism applied at the gravitational tier: Hilbert&#8217;s Lorentzian variational derivation and Jacobson&#8217;s Euclidean thermodynamic derivation are the two signature-readings of the McGucken manifold&#8217;s response to matter, with the McGucken-Wick rotation <em>τ = x₄/c</em> as the universal bridge. <em><strong>Third</strong></em>, the canonical commutation relation <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em> — the foundational identity of quantum mechanics, equivalent to the Heisenberg uncertainty relation and to the central postulate of the Dirac–von Neumann axiomatic system — is itself shown in the present paper to be the dual-channel output of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> through two structurally disjoint routes that share no intermediate machinery: the Hamiltonian route through Stone&#8217;s theorem on translation invariance (Propositions H.1–H.5, Lorentzian signature) and the Lagrangian route through Huygens-McGucken Sphere path integral (Propositions L.1–L.6, Euclidean signature), with full proofs imported from [MQF]. The Heisenberg-Feynman equivalence observed for 75 years is thereby placed alongside the Hilbert-Jacobson agreement and the Feynman-Wiener correspondence as the third dual-channel agreement of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. <em><strong>Fourth</strong></em>, the framework is falsifiable: if any one of the dual-channel agreements (Feynman-Wiener at the QM-statistical-mechanics correspondence, Heisenberg-Feynman at the canonical commutation relation, Hilbert-Jacobson at the Einstein field equations) were to fail in any regime, the McGucken framework is refuted. No such failure has ever been observed across the empirical record of theoretical physics. The <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> framework is therefore empirically corroborated at every level by the structural agreements that have been independently verified, and it is the only known framework supplying a <em>physical mechanism</em> for these agreements rather than treating them as remarkable formal coincidences.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The principal new result of the present paper is the <strong>Universal McGucken Channel B Theorem</strong>, which states that <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>&#8216;s geometric-propagation channel — iterated McGucken Sphere expansion on the McGucken manifold — is the <em>same mathematical object</em> whose Lorentzian-signature reading produces the Feynman path integral of quantum mechanics and whose Euclidean-signature reading produces the Wiener process of classical statistical mechanics, with the McGucken-Wick rotation <em>τ = x₄/c</em> connecting the two readings and the same geometric object operating universally at both the matter tier (yielding QM and statistical mechanics) and the gravitational tier (yielding Hilbert&#8217;s and Jacobson&#8217;s derivations of <em>G_μν</em>). In all three diverse instances — QM, GR, and thermodynamics — the physical phenomena are dually-determined, forced, and unified by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. This paper demonstrates that in all three instances — (1) the QM instance (<em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em>, with full proofs imported from [MQF]), (2) the statistical-mechanical instance (the strict Second Law <em>dS/dt = (3/2)k_B/t</em>, with full proofs imported from [MGT]), and (3) the gravitational instance (<em>G_μν + Λg_μν = (8πG/c⁴)T_μν</em>, derived in §§3–6) — the separate Channel B derivations all rest upon the same geometric object arising from <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>: iterated McGucken Sphere expansion on the McGucken manifold, integrated in two different signatures — the Lorentzian and the Euclidean. The Lorentzian reading produces, at the matter level, the Feynman path integral with phase <em>exp(iS/ℏ)</em> yielding the Schrödinger equation and the QM canonical commutation relation; the same Lorentzian reading applied to the gravitational tier produces Hilbert&#8217;s variational derivation of <em>G_μν</em> on Lorentzian signature (−,+,+,+). The Euclidean reading produces, at the matter level, the Wiener process with measure <em>exp(−S_E/ℏ)</em> yielding Brownian motion and the strict Second Law of Thermodynamics; the same Euclidean reading applied to the gravitational tier produces Jacobson&#8217;s thermodynamic derivation of <em>G_μν</em> on the Wick-rotated horizon geometry. The matter-level pair (QM ↔ statistical mechanics) is related by the standard Kac–Nelson Wick-rotation correspondence; the gravitational-level pair (Hilbert ↔ Jacobson) is related by the same Wick rotation applied to the McGucken manifold itself. The McGucken Principle supplies what Kac and Nelson did not, and what &#8216;t Hooft, Verlinde, Padmanabhan, and Jacobson have each separately sought: a <em>physical mechanism</em> for the rotation. The Wick rotation <em>τ = x₄/c</em> is not a formal device but a coordinate identification on the real four-manifold whose fourth axis is physically expanding at velocity <em>c</em> — <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. The same rotation operates universally at all three instances because the McGucken manifold is universal.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Theorem unifies quantum mechanics and classical statistical mechanics structurally. They are not different theories at different scales but two signature-readings of the same geometric process — iterated McGucken Sphere propagation on the McGucken manifold. Seventy-five years of Feynman-Kac, Nelson stochastic mechanics, Osterwalder-Schrader reflection positivity, Parisi-Wu stochastic quantization, and Symanzik Euclidean field theory have observed this mathematical equivalence as a remarkable formal correspondence without identifying its physical source. The McGucken Principle identifies the physical source.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Gravity sits one structural tier above this matter-level duality. Where QM and statistical mechanics are signature-readings of <em>matter dynamics on a fixed McGucken background</em>, the Hilbert–Jacobson agreement on <em>G_μν</em> is the signature-reading of <em>the McGucken background&#8217;s own response to matter</em>. The present paper&#8217;s main technical result, the <em>Signature-Bridging Theorem</em> (Theorem 6.1), establishes that Hilbert (1915, Lorentzian variational) and Jacobson (1995, Euclidean thermodynamic) agree on <em>G_μν</em> because they are two signature-readings of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> applied at the gravitational tier — exactly as Heisenberg-Feynman (1925, 1948) and Brownian motion are two signature-readings of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> applied at the matter tier.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The structural unification is therefore two-tiered: at Tier 1, matter on the McGucken manifold admits a Lorentzian-Euclidean signature duality manifesting as QM versus classical statistical mechanics; at Tier 2, the gravitational response of the McGucken manifold to matter admits the same duality manifesting as Hilbert&#8217;s variational derivation versus Jacobson&#8217;s thermodynamic derivation of <em>G_μν</em>. The two tiers are coupled through Einstein&#8217;s equations: matter at Tier 1 sources gravity at Tier 2. The whole structure descends from <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at the foundational tier (Tier 0). The Wick rotation <em>τ = x₄/c</em> is the universal bridge between Lorentzian and Euclidean signatures at both tiers; it is universal because the McGucken manifold is universal.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A further structural identification follows. <strong>Huygens&#8217; Principle is the holographic principle</strong>: every spacetime event is the apex of a McGucken Sphere, every McGucken Sphere is a holographic screen, and the bulk-to-boundary encoding mechanism that the holographic principle of &#8216;t Hooft (1993) and Susskind (1994) has assumed without explanation for thirty years is the surface-sourcing of bulk wavefronts by Huygens secondary wavelets. The Bekenstein bound <em>N_bulk ≤ A/(4ℓ_p²)</em> is the count of <em>x₄</em>-modes per Planck cell on the McGucken Sphere surface. AdS/CFT is the special case of this universal McGucken-Sphere holography in anti-de Sitter geometry. The &#8216;t Hooft dimensional-reduction pattern (classical statistical mechanics in <em>d</em> dimensions ↔ quantum field theory in <em>d−1</em> dimensions) is the bulk-boundary instance of the same Wick rotation that bridges QM and statistical mechanics at Tier 1. Four great structural mysteries of foundational physics — the Lorentzian-Euclidean equivalence (Kac, Nelson, Symanzik), the holographic principle (&#8216;t Hooft, Susskind, Maldacena), gravitational thermodynamics (Jacobson, Verlinde, Padmanabhan), and AdS/CFT duality (Maldacena) — collapse into four facets of one geometric process: the spherically symmetric expansion of <em>x₄</em> at velocity <em>c</em> from every spacetime event.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The framework imports the full QM proofs of <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em> (Propositions H.1–H.5 Hamiltonian route, L.1–L.6 Lagrangian route) from McGucken (2026) [MQF] as standalone content, and the full thermodynamic chain proofs (Theorems 4–9 Compton-coupling Brownian mechanism, Theorems 12–13 dissolutions of Loschmidt and the Past Hypothesis) from McGucken (2026) [MGT]. The Compton coupling between matter and <em>x₄</em> at frequency <em>ω_C = mc²/ℏ</em> supplies the Channel B microscopic mechanism for both the QM path integral (each path accumulates Compton phase along <em>x₄</em>) and the thermodynamic Wiener process (each Compton period redistributes the particle isotropically over the McGucken Sphere). The two are <em>the same Compton oscillation read in two signatures</em>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A final structural property of the McGucken Principle deserves prominent statement. The principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is <em>cross-generative</em>: the mathematics generates the physics and the physics generates the mathematics, ad infinitum, via the greater Huygens&#8217; Principle embodied in <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. Every theorem of the framework is simultaneously a mathematical identity (the algebraic-symmetry content of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> yielding operator algebra and conservation laws via Stone, Noether, Haar) and a physical phenomenon (the geometric-propagation content of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> yielding wavefronts, path integrals, entropy flows, gravitational responses), with each generating the other through iterated McGucken Sphere expansion. The Schrödinger equation is at once an operator-algebra identity and a Huygens-wavefront propagation; the Einstein field equations are at once a tensor identity and a horizon-thermodynamic balance; the canonical commutation relation is at once a Stone-theorem corollary and a Compton-phase accumulation rule. The mathematics is the physics; the physics is the mathematics; and the channel by which each generates the other is the iterated spherically symmetric expansion of <em>x₄</em> at velocity <em>c</em> from every spacetime event — the greater Huygens&#8217; Principle of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A related structural observation, holding in both the physical and the mathematical realm. The McGucken Principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> has the remarkable property of containing both <em>being</em> and <em>becoming</em> in a dual-containment relation: the being contains the becoming, and the becoming contains the being. <em>In the physical realm</em>: the <em>physical being</em> of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is the invariant rate <em>ic</em> — the unchanging fact that every spacetime event has the same <em>x₄</em>-expansion rate, the Erlangen-programme symmetry content of the principle, the static identity that grounds Channel A&#8217;s algebraic-symmetry derivations. The <em>physical becoming</em> of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is the active spherical expansion at velocity <em>c</em> — the dynamical process that every spacetime event is the source of an isotropic wavefront, the Bergson-style geometric flow that grounds Channel B&#8217;s geometric-propagation derivations. The physical being contains the physical becoming because the invariance <em>is</em> the rate <em>c</em> of the active expansion; the physical becoming contains the physical being because the active expansion <em>is</em> at the unchanging rate <em>c</em>. The two are not separable. <em>In the mathematical realm</em>: the same dual-containment is instantiated in the relation between <em>space</em> (the mathematical being) and the <em>operators</em> that act on space (the mathematical becoming). The space contains the operators as derivations of its symmetry algebra — momentum <em>p̂</em> is the generator of spatial translation along <em>ℝ³</em>, angular momentum is the generator of spatial rotation, the Hamiltonian is the generator of time translation. The operators contain the space as their representation domain — the Hilbert space <em>ℋ = L²(ℝ³)</em> on which <em>p̂, q̂, Ĥ</em> act <em>is</em> the underlying space <em>ℝ³</em> lifted into representation-theoretic form. There is no operator without the space to act on; there is no space without the operators that generate its symmetries. The being-becoming duality is therefore not a philosophical commentary but a structural feature of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> that holds in both the physical and mathematical realms and is instantiated at every tier of the framework.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">§1 Introduction: The Hilbert–Jacobson Agreement and the Signature Problem</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Since 1915, the Einstein field equations have admitted derivations from at least two structurally independent starting points. The first, due to Hilbert in November 1915, varies the Einstein–Hilbert action and uses the diffeomorphism invariance of the gravitational Lagrangian to enforce the contracted Bianchi identity ∇^μ G_μν = 0 [1]. The second, due to Jacobson in 1995, treats the field equations as a thermodynamic equation of state, deriving them from the Clausius relation δQ = TdS applied to all local Rindler horizons [2]. Their agreement on the same field equations is, on standard accounts, a remarkable structural fact about gravity.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The agreement is more remarkable than is usually recognised. Hilbert and Jacobson do not merely use different mathematical formalisms — they operate in <em>different metric signatures</em>. Hilbert&#8217;s variational derivation is Lorentzian: the action S = ∫d⁴x √(−g) R is integrated over Lorentzian spacetime, with the minus sign in the metric signature (−,+,+,+) supplying the structural content from which the field equations emerge. Jacobson&#8217;s thermodynamic derivation is Euclidean: the Unruh temperature is obtained from periodicity under rotation by 2π in the Wick-rotated (x, x₄)-plane, the KMS condition identifies imaginary-time periodicity with inverse temperature, and the Clausius relation operates on horizons whose temperature structure is defined by analytic continuation to Euclidean signature.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Two derivations of the same equation in two different signatures cannot share a common kernel unless something bridges the signatures.</strong> This is the central observation of the present paper, and the bridge is the physical reality of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The standard treatment of the Lorentzian–Euclidean relation in quantum field theory is the Wick rotation t → −iτ, introduced by Wick in 1954 [9] as a calculational device justified by the analyticity properties of correlation functions. Under this reading, the Wick rotation is a formal manoeuvre with no physical content of its own. It cannot serve as a structural bridge between two physical derivations, because a formal device cannot supply the shared content required for two physical derivations to converge on the same physical equation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">McGucken (2026) [W] changes this. The Wick rotation is shown to be not a formal device but a <em>coordinate identification on the real four-dimensional McGucken manifold</em>: τ = x₄/c, with the Lorentzian time coordinate t and the Euclidean coordinate τ being the same x₄-axis read in two notations. The substitution t → −iτ is the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic written in different units. This is the Central Theorem of the Wick-rotation paper [W, Theorem 6], reproduced here as Theorem 2.1.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The consequence is the present paper&#8217;s principal result. Hilbert&#8217;s Lorentzian variational derivation and Jacobson&#8217;s Euclidean thermodynamic derivation, which cannot share a kernel through any formal device, share a kernel through the <em>real geometric object</em> that the McGucken Principle identifies: the expanding fourth dimension whose Lorentzian-signature reading produces Hilbert&#8217;s derivation (Channel A) and whose Euclidean-signature reading produces Jacobson&#8217;s derivation (Channel B). The Hilbert–Jacobson agreement on G_μν + Λg_μν = (8πG/c⁴) T_μν is therefore <em>necessary, not contingent</em> — it is forced by the existence of dx₄/dt = ic as the physical source from which both derivations descend.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This paper proves the Signature-Bridging Theorem and develops its two consequences.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Necessity (first implication).</strong> Hilbert and Jacobson had to agree because they are reading the same x₄-expansion in two different metric signatures. The McGucken framework predicts <em>n-channel agreement</em>: any future derivation of G_μν in any signature obtainable from Lorentzian by Wick rotation with τ = x₄/c — including Euclidean lattice quantum gravity, complex-metric Kontsevich–Segal formulations, AdS/CFT holographic derivations, and Verlinde&#8217;s entropic gravity at the relativistic level — must agree with Hilbert and Jacobson.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Falsifiability (second implication).</strong> The result is mathematically decidable. If a derivation of G_μν is constructed in a signature that cannot be obtained from Lorentzian by Wick rotation with τ = x₄/c, and it nonetheless agrees with Hilbert and Jacobson, the McGucken framework is refuted. Conversely, the Wick-rotation theorem τ = x₄/c is predicted to be the exhaustive characterization of signatures in which G_μν admits a derivation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>A structural property to be developed below.</strong> The McGucken Principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> exhibits a <em>cross-generative</em> relation between mathematics and physics that informs the entire derivational architecture of the paper. The mathematics generates the physics — the algebraic-symmetry content of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> yields, via Stone&#8217;s theorem, Noether&#8217;s theorem, Haar&#8217;s theorem, Lovelock&#8217;s theorem, and the Stone–von Neumann uniqueness theorem, the operator algebras of QM, the variational principles of GR, the conservation laws of mechanics. The physics generates the mathematics — the geometric-propagation content of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> yields, via iterated McGucken Sphere expansion, the Feynman path integral, the Wiener process, the horizon thermodynamics, the Bekenstein bound. Each generates the other ad infinitum, via the <em>greater Huygens&#8217; Principle</em> embodied in <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>: every spacetime event is the apex of a McGucken Sphere whose surface is at once a mathematical object (a measure space, a homogeneous space SO(3)/SO(2), a holographic screen) and a physical object (a wavefront, an entropy-bearing horizon, an isotropy-generating surface). The mathematics is the physics; the physics is the mathematics.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The principle further exhibits a <em>being-becoming dual containment</em> that holds in both the physical and the mathematical realm. <em>In the physical realm</em>, the principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> contains both <em>physical being</em> — the unchanging rate <em>ic</em>, the invariance group of the principle (translations, rotations, boosts that leave the rate fixed), the static algebraic identities that ground Channel A — and <em>physical becoming</em> — the active spherical expansion at velocity <em>c</em>, the wavefront propagation, the dynamical processes that ground Channel B. The physical being contains the physical becoming because the invariance <em>is</em> the rate of the active expansion; the physical becoming contains the physical being because the active expansion <em>is</em> at the invariant rate. <em>In the mathematical realm</em>, the same dual containment appears as the relation between <em>space</em> (the mathematical being: the underlying manifold <em>ℝ³</em> with its symmetry group SO(3) ⋉ <em>ℝ³</em> and its Hilbert lift <em>L²(ℝ³)</em>) and the <em>operators</em> that act on space (the mathematical becoming: <em>p̂, q̂, Ĥ</em> and their algebraic relations including <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em>). The space contains the operators as derivations of its symmetry algebra — every operator is a generator of a symmetry of the underlying space. The operators contain the space as their representation domain — every operator algebra is realised on a Hilbert space that <em>is</em> the space lifted into representation-theoretic form. The two realms reflect the same dual containment: physical being contains physical becoming as the invariance contains the rate; mathematical being contains mathematical becoming as the space contains the operators that generate its symmetries; and the McGucken Principle is the foundational instance in which both realms exhibit the same structural property. The present paper develops the consequences at the three tiers of physics: the matter level (QM and statistical mechanics as Channel A and Channel B Tier 1 readings; §7), the gravitational level (Hilbert and Jacobson derivations as Channel A and Channel B Tier 2 readings; §§3–6), and the structural-mechanism level (Huygens equals holography on McGucken Spheres throughout spacetime; §7.9.4).</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">§2 The McGucken Principle and the Invariant/Deformable Split</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>A paper-wide convention.</em> The present paper draws a load-bearing distinction between the dynamical principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> — the active physical statement that the fourth dimension expands at velocity <em>c</em> in a spherically symmetric manner from every spacetime event — and the integrated kinematic form <em>x₄ = ict + const</em>, which is the static algebraic shadow of the dynamical principle obtained by integration with an arbitrary origin choice. The two are related by one calculus operation in each direction (differentiating <em>x₄ = ict</em> with respect to <em>t</em> gives <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>; integrating <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> with origin choice <em>x₄(0) = 0</em> gives <em>x₄ = ict</em>), but their <em>physical content</em> is asymmetric and the entire derivational content of the paper rests on the asymmetry. The dynamical principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is <em>primary</em>: it is the physical postulate from which all theorems descend. The integrated form <em>x₄ = ict</em> is <em>secondary</em>: it is a coordinate-level convenience for re-expressing the Minkowski line element in pseudo-Euclidean form, with no additional physical content beyond the dynamical principle. Throughout this paper, every theorem invokes <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> as the load-bearing input; the integrated form <em>x₄ = ict</em> appears only as a notational convenience where useful. §2.6 develops this asymmetry at length in a dedicated subsection, listing eight specific derivations that fail if the static reading is substituted for the dynamical reading.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">§2.1 Statement</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The McGucken Principle is the physical statement that the fourth dimension <em>x</em>₄ expands isotropically at the rate <em>c</em> from every spacetime event. Mathematically:</p>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>dx₄/dt = ic.</em> <em>(2.1)</em></p>
</blockquote>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The expansion has three properties [3, 4]:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>(i)</em> <strong>Invariance</strong>: the rate <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is the same at every spacetime point, unaffected by the presence of mass, energy, or curvature in the three spatial dimensions.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>(ii)</em> <strong>Spherical symmetry</strong>: the expansion proceeds isotropically from every point, with no preferred spatial direction.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>(iii)</em> <strong>Monotonicity</strong>: <em>x</em>₄ advances; it does not retreat. There is no process by which <em>x</em>₄ contracts or reverses.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The notation <em>x</em>₄ = <em>ict</em>, which appears in Minkowski&#8217;s 1908 paper [5] and was treated by the subsequent physics community [8] as a formal device, is read here as the <em>kinematic descriptor</em> of (2.1): if the fourth dimension advances at rate <em>c</em> relative to the three spatial dimensions, and if its metric character carries the imaginary unit <em>i</em> required by Lorentzian signature, then <em>x</em>₄ = <em>ict</em> and (2.1) follows by differentiation. The dynamical claim is the expansion; (2.1) is its formal expression.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">§2.2 The four-velocity budget as kinematic content</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Every massive particle satisfies the four-velocity normalisation</p>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>u^μ u_μ = −c²</em> <em>(2.2)</em></p>
</blockquote>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">with <em>u^μ ≡ dx^μ/dτ</em> the four-velocity. The standard textbook reading of (2.2) is that proper time <em>τ</em> is defined to make this identity hold. The McGucken reading is the inverse: (2.2) is the <em>budget constraint</em> arising from the fact that the fourth dimension is in active expansion at rate <em>c</em>. The four-speed budget of every object is fixed at <em>c</em>; spatial motion at speed <em>v</em> leaves <em>√(c² − v²)</em> for advance through <em>x</em>₄, with the limiting cases <em>v</em> = 0 (full <em>x</em>₄-advance, the rest frame) and <em>v</em> = <em>c</em> (zero <em>x</em>₄-advance, the photon) [3, 4].</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This reading converts (2.2) from a definitional identity into a <em>physical</em> constraint. The constraint is satisfied because <em>x</em>₄ is expanding at <em>c</em>, and every particle&#8217;s four-motion is the resultant of its spatial motion with the <em>x</em>₄-expansion that carries it along. (2.2) is a theorem of (2.1).</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">§2.3 The Wick rotation as a theorem</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Wick rotation <em>t → −iτ</em> connecting Lorentzian and Euclidean signatures is treated in standard quantum field theory as a formal device justified by analyticity of correlation functions [9]. Within the McGucken framework, the rotation is a <em>coordinate identification</em>: if <em>x</em>₄ = <em>ict</em>, then <em>t = x₄/(ic) = −ix₄/c</em>. Writing <em>τ ≡ x₄/c</em> for the proper-time-like <em>x</em>₄-coordinate (with units of time), this gives</p>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>t = −iτ, τ = x₄/c.</em> <em>(2.3)</em></p>
</blockquote>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Wick rotation is the identification of the time parameter with <em>−i</em> times the <em>x</em>₄-coordinate. It is not a formal device but a statement about the geometric relation between <em>t</em> and <em>x</em>₄. This will be used in §5 as the bridge between Channels A and B.</p>



<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Theorem 2.1 (Wick rotation as McGucken corollary).</strong> <em>Given the physical principle <strong>dx₄/dt = ic</strong> — the dynamical statement that the fourth dimension expands at velocity c — the standard Wick rotation t → −iτ of quantum field theory is the coordinate identification τ = x₄/c on the real four-dimensional McGucken manifold.</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em><strong>Proof.</strong></em> <em>The dynamical principle dx₄/dt = ic is the load-bearing input. Integrating dx₄/dt = ic with origin choice x₄(0) = 0 (a coordinate convention carrying no physical content beyond fixing the origin) gives the integrated kinematic form x₄ = ict, a static algebraic relation that is the calculus shadow of the dynamical principle and not the primary content. Solving for t in terms of x₄ gives t = x₄/(ic) = (1/(ic))·x₄ = (−i/c)·x₄ = −i·(x₄/c) = −iτ where τ ≡ x₄/c. Hence t = −iτ with τ = x₄/c, which is the standard Wick rotation of QFT [9] read here as a coordinate identification on the real McGucken manifold rather than as a formal analytic continuation. ∎</em></p>
</blockquote>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">§2.4 The invariant/deformable split</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The McGucken Principle distinguishes the four directions of spacetime: <em>x</em>₄ is <em>invariant</em> (its expansion rate is <em>c</em> everywhere, unaffected by matter); <em>x</em>₁, <em>x</em>₂, <em>x</em>₃ are <em>deformable</em> (they stretch and bend in the presence of mass-energy). This is <em>not</em> a diffeomorphism — diffeomorphism invariance treats all four coordinates symmetrically. The McGucken split breaks the four directions into one invariant direction (<em>x</em>₄) and three deformable directions (spatial).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The physical content: <strong>gravity arises because <em>x</em>₄&#8217;s expansion at <em>c</em> is invariant while space <em>x</em>₁<em>x</em>₂<em>x</em>₃ bends and stretches</strong>. An invariant <em>x</em>₄-wavelength of light measured against stretched spatial rulers near a mass exhibits gravitational redshift; an invariant <em>x</em>₄-advance rate measured against stretched spatial geometry exhibits gravitational time dilation. The Schwarzschild metric, the field equations, the Raychaudhuri equation, and the entire phenomenology of gravity are consequences of this rigid/deformable distinction.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This split is the structural input to Channel A.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">§2.5 The Two McGucken Channels A &amp; B: Algebraic-Symmetry and Geometric-Propagation Readings of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A vast wealth of physics is gained via <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>&#8216;s physical exaltation of both algebraic-symmetry and geometric-propagation. The remainder of this paper deploys two distinct readings of the McGucken Principle (2.1) — <em>Channel A</em> (the algebraic-symmetry reading) and <em>Channel B</em> (the geometric-propagation reading) — which we now introduce as structural concepts before applying them, following the formal treatment in the GR-QM unification paper [GRQM, §3]. This subsection states what each channel <em>is</em>, why both descend from the same single physical equation, and how their joint action across general relativity, quantum mechanics, and thermodynamics constitutes the McGucken Duality that closes the foundational gap of twentieth-century physics.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Channel A: The algebraic-symmetry reading.</strong> Channel A asks: <em>what transformations leave the McGucken Principle invariant?</em> The principle states that <em>x₄</em> advances at the same rate from every spacetime event, in every spatial direction, at every time. The principle is therefore invariant under (i) translations along <em>x</em>₄ itself (the rate is independent of <em>x</em>₄&#8217;s value), (ii) translations along <em>x</em>₁, <em>x</em>₂, <em>x</em>₃ (the rate is independent of spatial location), (iii) translations along <em>t</em> (the rate is independent of time), and (iv) rotations of the spatial three-coordinates (the rate has no preferred spatial direction). Combining (ii) with (iv) yields the spatial isometry group <em>ISO(3) = SO(3) ⋉ ℝ³</em> at the spatial-three-slice level. Combining all four with the Lorentz boost invariance forced by the <em>i</em> in <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> yields the Poincaré group <em>ISO(1,3)</em> at the four-dimensional level [F].</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Channel A is therefore the <em>invariance-group content</em> of the principle. Through Noether&#8217;s 1918 theorem, every continuous symmetry generates a conservation law: time-translation invariance gives energy conservation; spatial-translation invariance gives momentum conservation; spatial-rotation invariance gives angular-momentum conservation; <em>x</em>₄-translation invariance gives the conservation laws of relativistic four-momentum. Channel A is the universe&#8217;s self-similarity under transformation. Its derivative deliverables, developed in §§3, 7.1, and elsewhere, include: the Minkowski metric and Lorentz invariance; the Hilbert variational derivation of the Einstein field equations; the canonical commutation relation <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em> through Stone&#8217;s theorem on translation invariance; the Born rule through the Cauchy functional equation; the Haar measure on classical phase space via Haar&#8217;s theorem on ISO(3). Channel A operates in <em>Lorentzian signature</em> throughout, because the symmetry generators (Stone&#8217;s theorem, Noether currents, Poincaré algebra) are time-symmetric and operate in real-time operator algebra.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Channel B: The geometric-propagation reading.</strong> Channel B asks: <em>what does the McGucken Principle generate when applied at every spacetime event?</em> From every event <em>p₀ = (x₀, t₀)</em>, the principle states that <em>x</em>₄ advances at rate <em>c</em> in a spherically symmetric manner. The locus of points reachable from <em>p</em>₀ by light-speed propagation in the spatial three-slice is a sphere of radius <em>R(t) = c(t − t₀)</em> — the <em>McGucken Sphere</em> — expanding monotonically as <em>t</em> increases. Every point of the McGucken Sphere is itself the source of a new McGucken Sphere by Huygens&#8217; Principle (Proposition L.1 of §7.2 and Theorem 4.1 of §4.1): the iterated structure of the wavefront is the geometric content of <em>x</em>₄&#8217;s expansion at every event.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Channel B is therefore the <em>wavefront content</em> of the principle. Its derivative deliverables, developed in §§4, 7.2, and elsewhere, include: the Schwarzschild metric as the Birkhoff-unique geometry preserving spherical <em>x</em>₄-expansion outside a mass; the Friedmann equation from spatially homogeneous <em>x</em>₄-expansion; the Schrödinger equation from short-time Huygens propagation on the McGucken Sphere; the Feynman path integral from iterated McGucken Sphere composition; the Wiener process and the strict Second Law from the same Compton coupling Wick-rotated to Euclidean signature; the Bekenstein-Hawking horizon entropy from <em>x</em>₄-mode counting on horizon McGucken Spheres. Channel B operates in <em>Euclidean signature</em> through the Wick rotation <em>τ = x₄/c</em> established in Theorem 2.1, because the geometric-propagation arguments require integration over real positive measures (probability densities, entropy counts, area bounds). Channel B is the universe&#8217;s geometric flow forward in time.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Why both channels descend from the same single equation.</strong> The McGucken Principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is a single physical statement whose content is, structurally, two-fold by inspection. (a) It is a statement of <em>uniform rate</em>: the rate is <em>c</em>, independent of where, when, and in what direction one looks. From the rate&#8217;s uniformity, the invariance group of the principle is read off directly — this is Channel A. (b) It is a statement of <em>spherical expansion</em>: the rate is <em>c</em>, applied at every event in a spherically symmetric manner from that event. From the spherical expansion, the wavefront structure of the principle is read off directly — this is Channel B. The two readings are not two derivations of two principles; they are two readings of one principle, factored along two different but compatible structural directions.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This factorization is universal: at the matter level (§7), Channel A produces operator-algebraic quantum mechanics and Channel B produces the path integral / Wiener process; at the gravitational level (§§3–4), Channel A produces Hilbert&#8217;s variational <em>G_μν</em> and Channel B produces Jacobson&#8217;s thermodynamic <em>G_μν</em>. The dual-channel structure is the McGucken Duality. We claim that the McGucken Principle is the first single physical equation in the history of foundational physics from which both Channel A and Channel B descend by direct geometric inspection, in both QM and GR, as parallel sibling consequences.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>The joint forcing.</strong> Channel A and Channel B are not independent of each other within any given derivation. Every theorem of the framework is jointly forced by both channels acting in concert. Channel A supplies the symmetry structure that constrains the form of the theorem; Channel B supplies the geometric realization that determines its empirical content. The Schrödinger equation is a clear example: Channel A supplies the Hamiltonian operator <em>Ĥ</em> generating time translation and the canonical commutation relation <em>[q̂, p̂] = iℏ</em> from the principle&#8217;s Lorentz invariance combined with the Compton-frequency advance of <em>x</em>₄; Channel B supplies the wave-amplitude propagation <em>ψ(x, t)</em> on the McGucken Sphere from the principle&#8217;s spherical expansion. The Schrödinger equation <em>iℏ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ</em> is the joint statement: the Channel A operator structure generates the time-evolution of the Channel B wavefront. Neither channel alone produces it; both are required. The same joint forcing operates for the Einstein field equations: Channel A supplies diffeomorphism invariance (Bianchi tensorial structure, stress-energy conservation); Channel B supplies null-cone propagation on McGucken Spheres (causal structure); the joint statement is <em>G_μν = (8πG/c⁴) T_μν</em>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>The Huygens point-sphere duality and the McGucken Channels A and B.</strong> The dual-channel architecture introduced above has a structural template that predates it by three and a third centuries. Christiaan Huygens stated in his 1690 <em>Traité de la Lumière</em> [«Huygens 1690»] that every point on an advancing wavefront is itself a source of secondary spherical wavelets, and the envelope of these secondary wavelets at the next instant is the new wavefront — a <em>reciprocal-generative</em> relation between points and spheres: the sphere is generated by its surface points as wavelet-sources, and the surface points of the new sphere are generated by the envelope of the wavelets they themselves sourced. The structural template is point → sphere → point → sphere → … ad infinitum, with each iteration generating the next through the spherical-wavelet rule. Huygens identified this template in the context of optical propagation; the McGucken framework recognises it as the foundational template of <em>all</em> of mathematical physics under <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The McGucken Channels A and B <em>are</em> the physical realisation of the Huygens point-sphere duality at the foundational level. Channel A — the algebraic-symmetry reading — is the <em>operator side</em> of the duality: every point of the underlying space is the locus of a generative operator (translation, rotation, boost, gauge transformation, diffeomorphism — every operator of physics is a generator of a continuous symmetry of the underlying space). Channel B — the geometric-propagation reading — is the <em>space side</em> of the duality: every point of the underlying space is itself the <em>source of a McGucken Sphere</em>, and the McGucken Sphere is the universal Huygens wavelet that the principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> generates at every spacetime event. The Channel A operator and the Channel B sphere are not two separate objects; they are the two faces of the Huygens point-sphere duality applied to <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. The operator (Channel A) acts on the space; the space (Channel B) generates the McGucken Sphere whose surface points act as Huygens sources, and the action of these sources generates a new space whose every point is again the locus of a generative operator. The reciprocal-generative iteration <em>point → sphere → point → sphere → …</em> is the universal structural template of the McGucken Duality.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The reciprocal-generative nature of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is realised in both realms. (1) In the <em>physical realm</em>: <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> generates the Lorentzian spacetime metric (via Proposition H.1 and the four-velocity budget <em>u^μu_μ = −c²</em> of §2.2), and every point of that Lorentzian spacetime in turn embodies <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> as the local rate of <em>x₄</em>-advance from that point — i.e., every point is the apex of a new McGucken Sphere generated by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at that point. (2) In the <em>mathematical realm</em>: the McGucken source-pair <em>(ℳ_G, D_M)</em> — where <em>ℳ_G</em> is the McGucken space (the four-manifold on which physics is staged, equipped with the <em>x₄</em>-foliation structure of §3.1) and <em>D_M</em> is the McGucken operator family (the generators of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>&#8216;s symmetry algebra: translation, rotation, boost, the McGucken-Wick rotation, the Compton-coupling, the Huygens-McGucken Sphere sourcing) — is <em>co-generated</em>: every point of <em>ℳ_G</em> is itself a generative operator in <em>D_M</em> (a generator of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at that point), and the family of operators <em>D_M</em> reciprocally generates <em>ℳ_G</em> as the manifold on which they act. The two are <em>jointly co-generated by the single physical relation dx₄/dt = ic</em>. This is the McGucken source-pair structure developed at length in [GRQM]; the present paper imports it as standalone structural content here.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The fact that the mathematics and the physics, both born of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>, mirror one another in their reciprocal-generative properties is both <em>remarkable</em> and <em>natural</em>. It is remarkable because nothing in the prior literature has identified a single physical principle from which both the mathematical and the physical structures of foundational physics co-generate reciprocally. It is natural because <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is the principle that <em>is</em> the reciprocal-generation: the <em>i</em> is the perpendicularity of <em>x₄</em> (the point-sphere duality at the algebraic level), the <em>c</em> is the rate of the McGucken Sphere expansion (the wavelet-sourcing at the geometric level), and the principle <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> is the simultaneous statement of both — a single physical equation whose every reading produces a new generative operation and whose every operation produces a new readable physical phenomenon.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This recovers and sharpens the cross-generative claim stated in the abstract and in §1: the mathematics generates the physics, and the physics generates the mathematics, ad infinitum, via the greater Huygens&#8217; Principle embodied in <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. The McGucken Channels A and B are <em>self-generative</em> within their own domains (Channel A is the operator face that generates new operator content; Channel B is the space face that generates new spatial wavefronts), <em>reciprocally generative</em> between their own domains (the operator acts on the space; the space sources the McGucken Sphere whose surface points act as operators), and <em>cross-generative</em> between the physical and mathematical realms (the physical reading of <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> generates the mathematical structure of the McGucken source-pair; the mathematical structure of the McGucken source-pair in turn generates the physical content of the McGucken framework). All three generative modes — self, reciprocal, cross — are instances of the greater Huygens&#8217; Principle embodied in <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>: every point of the McGucken-physical-mathematical universe is the source of a generative wavelet, and the envelope of these wavelets is the universe itself, iterated through the McGucken Sphere structure at every event.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>The being-becoming dual containment instantiated in the McGucken Sphere itself.</strong> A particularly sharp instance of the being-becoming dual containment is visible directly in the McGucken Sphere, the geometric primitive generated by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at every spacetime event. The McGucken Sphere of radius <em>r = c·δt</em> from event <em>p₀</em> is, at the instant of its construction, a <em>being</em> — a determinate set of spatial points at distance <em>r</em> from <em>p₀</em>, an extant geometric object, a sphere that <em>is</em>. Yet every point <em>q</em> on this sphere&#8217;s surface is itself a spacetime event at which <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> holds, and the principle <em>at the point q</em> is the becoming that will, in the next interval <em>δt</em>, generate a new McGucken Sphere of radius <em>c·δt</em> about <em>q</em>. So the sphere&#8217;s surface points are simultaneously <em>being</em> (points that are, in this instant, on the sphere) and <em>becoming</em> (points that contain <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> and will, in the next instant, become spheres themselves). The dual containment is visible at the level of the geometric primitive: the McGucken Sphere is <em>being as completed becoming</em>; its surface points are <em>becoming in progress</em>; the two reciprocally generate the iterated Huygens-McGucken Sphere wavefront. The same dual containment that holds for the operator-space pair holds for the sphere-point pair, and for the same structural reason — <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> embedded in each.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The reciprocal generation of being and becoming in the operator-space case is, as discussed in the preceding paragraphs and developed at length in [GRQM] under the source-pair construction <em>(ℳ_G, D_M)</em>, not a metaphor but a <em>formal</em> structural fact: every point of the space <em>ℳ_G</em> is a generative operator in <em>D_M</em>, every operator in <em>D_M</em> is realised on the space <em>ℳ_G</em>, and the two are co-generated by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. The being-becoming dual containment is therefore <em>formally established</em> in the mathematical realm (the source-pair structure) and <em>geometrically visible</em> in the physical realm (the sphere-point structure of iterated McGucken Sphere expansion). They are the same structural fact under the McGucken Principle.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Cross-realm consequence: the spacetime metric and the quantum vacuum field as reciprocally generated under dx₄/dt = ic.</strong> The being-becoming dual containment has a substantive physical consequence at the foundational level that we now state explicitly. The Lorentzian spacetime metric <em>g_μν</em>, generated by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> via the four-velocity budget <em>u^μu_μ = −c²</em> (Proposition H.1) and the Minkowski signature it forces, is the <em>being</em> of the physical realm: an extant geometric structure on the four-manifold <em>ℳ_G</em>. Yet every point of this spacetime carries <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> — the principle holds at every event — and the principle at every event is the becoming that generates, through Channel B&#8217;s iterated McGucken Sphere expansion, the wavefront propagation that <em>is</em> the quantum vacuum field. Specifically: every point of spacetime is the apex of a McGucken Sphere whose surface modes (one per Planck cell, Theorem 4.2) are the local quantum-vacuum degrees of freedom, and the <em>x₄</em>-Compton oscillation of every massive particle at <em>ω_C = mc²/ℏ</em> (Proposition 4.5.1) couples each particle to this vacuum-mode structure. The quantum vacuum field is therefore <em>not</em> a separate object postulated alongside spacetime; it is the <em>Channel B reading</em> of the spacetime metric whose <em>Channel A reading</em> is the variational geometry of <em>G_μν</em>. The two are reciprocally generated under <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>: the spacetime metric (being) has every point carrying <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> (becoming); the <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at every point generates the iterated McGucken Sphere expansion that <em>is</em> the quantum vacuum field (becoming-as-being); and the quantum vacuum field&#8217;s mode structure at every event sources the local <em>x₄</em>-expansion that, integrated, <em>is</em> the spacetime metric (being-as-becoming). The vacuum and the metric are not two physical objects but one structural fact viewed through Channel A (metric, variational, being) and Channel B (vacuum, propagation, becoming), reciprocally generated under <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> in exactly the manner of the source-pair <em>(ℳ_G, D_M)</em> in the mathematical realm.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This dissolves, on the McGucken reading, one of the deepest unresolved problems in foundational quantum field theory: the relation between the spacetime metric and the quantum vacuum field. The standard QFT treatment postulates the spacetime metric as a fixed Lorentzian background and <em>separately</em> constructs the vacuum state of the quantum field on this fixed background, with the vacuum-metric relation left as an unresolved problem requiring either a quantum theory of gravity (in which the metric is treated as a quantum field too) or a more sophisticated ontological treatment of the vacuum as an emergent structure. The McGucken framework dissolves the problem: the vacuum and the metric are reciprocally generated by <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>, with the vacuum as the Channel B reading and the metric as the Channel A reading. Each contains the other; each generates the other; both descend from <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em> at every spacetime event. The vacuum-metric question is therefore not an open problem in foundational QFT but an artefact of treating Channel A and Channel B as independent constructions when they are reciprocally generated by the same physical principle.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Huygens point-sphere duality, recognised in 1690 as the structural template of optical propagation, is therefore recognised here as the structural template of all of mathematical physics under <em>dx₄/dt = ic</em>. The McGucken Channels A and B are the algebraic-symmetry and geometric-propagation realisations of this template at the foundational level. The four tables below tabulate the consequences of this structural template across the corpus, with Tables 2 and 3 specifically showing how the operator side (Channel A) and the space side (Channel B) of the Huygens duality realise themselves in the Lorentzian and Euclidean signatures of the McGucken Duality.</p>
